expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Five quick days across the island on a budget: Colombo and the elephants on the way to Kandy, a night in the tea country, a night by the sea after Mirissa beach, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 4 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a sightseeing tour of Colombo; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; Nuwara Eliya sightseeing and a tea plantation; the Bentota sightseeing tour; the Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
